summary: Q4 revenue of $2.05B and adjusted EPS of $1.74 beat consensus and the EPS whisper, but 40.2% gross margin only met the practical bar and the captured disclosure provided no Q1 guidance or capacity/product milestones. After the peer-led run-up, the solid backward-looking beat appears insufficient for the forward-heavy market bar, favoring a modest sell-the-news repricing; confidence is limited by the missing forward information.
